import asyncio
import pathlib
import httpstan.models
code=pathlib.Path("hello.stan").read_text()
name=httpstan.models.calculate_model_name(code)
try:
    module=httpstan.models.import_services_extension_module(name)
except (FileNotFoundError,ImportError):
    asyncio.run(httpstan.models.build_services_extension_module(code))
    module=httpstan.models.import_services_extension_module(name)
print("MODULE",module.__name__)
print("EXPORTS",dir(module))
assert module.get_param_names({})==[]
print("STAN_MODEL_WITHOUT_PARAMETERS")
